ScopeSentence: 改签路径 B：以本机 CPython 3.12.10 为验证机候选，授权一次只读清单探测运行（只读取解释器版本、内置与冻结模块、实际加载模块来源），不接受资产、不生成 Manifest、不正式运行、不关闭 DSP-004。
OwnerAuthorization: 2026-10-31: after the recorder offered to write the remaining items as a concrete plan for the owner to decide, the owner replied 继续推进.

Layer1.Setup: admin-owned dedicated runtime directory; SYSTEM and Administrators full control; run account read and execute; inheritance off
Layer1.Residual: an elevated process can still replace files or change ACL; T0 records an ACL snapshot hash and rechecks after the run

Layer2.Setup: supervisor opens every bound file allowing others read only, denying write and delete, and holds the handles until Python exits
Layer2.Residual: kernel-level or offline modification not covered; only files in the bound list are protected

Bytecode.Effect: no read of Lib __pycache__, no cache writes; T0 verifies the prefix directory is empty

CheckToUse.Frozen: frozen module code lives in python312.dll; its SHA binding covers it

T0Sequence: hash every bound file and block on any mismatch
record ACL snapshot hash and verify empty pycache prefix
open and hold all bound files with deny-write/deny-delete sharing
spawn python.exe -I -S -B -X pycache_prefix=<empty> <fixed entry> with no extra argv, environment or stdin

Callee: main image path by system query equals locked python.exe
sys.executable and one-time nonce echoed over the bound pipe

OD04OptionsDraft.Text: admin-owned dedicated runtime copy + held file handles + empty pycache prefix + outer supervisor for T0 and two-side identity
as A, using the official embeddable package (stdlib in one zip)
OD04OptionsDraft.RecorderView: optional; owner downloads and checks the official hash

FurtherAuthorizationsNeededIfAOrB: create dedicated runtime directory and set ACL (owner, elevated, changes the machine)
write and review the supervisor implementation; bind build SHA
